description: Build the /lookup endpoint per docs/API_DESIGN.md, replacing /translate and /generate-cards, plus its eval harness.

tasks.title: Parse layer: term/context split + input validation
tasks.description: As a developer, I want a parse layer that splits term into term+context and validates every input parameter, so malformed or oversized requests are rejected with 400 before any model call.
acceptanceCriteria: Splits term on the first '(' into term + context
Missing closing ')' is not an error — everything after '(' becomes context as-is
Extra/nested parens in context are stripped, not parsed (e.g. 'term (b (c))' → context 'b c')
term > 200 characters → 400
Missing required term or language → 400
Invalid enum value for language/ability/formality/audience/llm → 400
Defaults applied per API_DESIGN.md Inputs table (ability=beginner, formality=polite, audience=staff, llm=google)
node:test suite scaffolded (package.json test script) with unit tests covering every 'parse term' and route-level 400 row in API_DESIGN.md's Test coverage table
tasks.notes: Foundation for LK-002. Spec: API_DESIGN.md 'term and context' + Inputs table + Parse step. Supersedes old T0/T1 code — do not reuse api/src as a starting point per this project's PRD.

tasks.title: Prompt + Generate call (single LLM call, token/latency budget)
tasks.description: As a developer, I want a single LLM call that turns the parsed term+options into the blocks-and-groups JSON per the Model behavior spec, so the service has raw model output to validate and finish.
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt implements every rule in API_DESIGN.md's Model behavior section: intent translation, disambiguation into ≤4 ordered blocks, theme grouping (≤8 groups total, ≤10 cards/group), English group titles, register soft-anchor with the slang-never-spills-in rule, ability difficulty scaling including the 'none' floor, content quality bar, raw-JSON-only output
maxOutputTokens set to 20000
Request timeout set to 15s
Prompt is shared verbatim across all three llm backends via the existing LLM_REGISTRY dispatch
LLM-throws and LLM-times-out are distinguishable code paths (both currently surface as 502, but must not be the same catch branch, to allow future differentiated handling)
Manual/integration check: calling with term=bathroom, language=ja, formality=casual, audience=staff returns a shape matching API_DESIGN.md Example 1
tasks.notes: Depends on LK-001. Supersedes old T1/T2 code.

tasks.title: Response validation + Finish layer
tasks.description: As a developer, I want deterministic post-processing that validates the model's response and enforces every output limit, so the client never receives an out-of-contract shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Malformed or truncated model JSON → 502 'Invalid response'
Every card validated against the shared card validator (per-field guard) → 502 on invalid card
Bad formality value on a card → rejected or stripped
Trim to ≤4 blocks, ≤8 groups total, ≤10 cards/group — keeps items in the model's returned order, drops from the end
Boundary-exact cases (=4 blocks, =8 groups, =10 cards) produce no trim
Empty group is dropped (no other minimum enforced)
context is set: block card gets the input parenthetical, group card gets its group's title
Unit tests cover every 'validate + finish' row in API_DESIGN.md's Test coverage table, including the CRITICAL ones
tasks.notes: Depends on LK-002. Supersedes old T1 code (validate/finish portion).

tasks.title: /lookup route wiring
tasks.description: As the app (client), I want a working /lookup HTTP endpoint, so I can call it end-to-end instead of the legacy /translate and /generate-cards endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: /lookup route wired into api/src/index.js router with the same 204/405/404 behavior as existing routes
Unknown llm value → 400
Full happy-path request returns a valid { blocks } response end to end
node:test suite passes; every CRITICAL row in API_DESIGN.md's Test coverage table is green
Manual curl smoke test against all 3 worked examples in API_DESIGN.md (bathroom, dinner, water) returns plausible output
tasks.notes: Depends on LK-003. Last backend-only, curl-demoable slice — legacy endpoints untouched here (retirement is scoped to the client-rebuild project).

tasks.title: Eval harness
tasks.description: As a QA engineer, I want a pre-deploy eval harness for /lookup, so structural, correctness, and quality regressions are caught before they reach learners.
acceptanceCriteria: evals/lookup.eval.js checks structural invariants: ≤4 blocks, ≤8 groups, ≤10 cards, no near-duplicate cards, valid schema
Reading-correctness check against a golden set of known words/readings
LLM-judge pass on the conversational quality bar ('would a person say this to someone they want to connect with?')
Golden-set sampling strategy is documented (representative subset per axis, per API_DESIGN.md's Deferred note — not the full 576-combination cross-product)
Runnable pre-deploy and produces a pass/fail report
